name: OFG Bancorp
summary: OFG Bancorp, a financial holding company, provides a range of banking and financial services in the United States. It operates through three segments: Banking, Wealth Management, and Treasury. The company offers savings accounts, certificates of deposit, individual retirement accounts personal, and commercial non-interest and interest-bearing checking accounts; time deposit products; and corporate trust services. It also provides commercial loans, auto loans, mortgage loans, as well as consumer loans, such as personal loans, residential solar panel loans, credit cards, lines of credit, and other loans; mortgage banking services; sale of loans and securitization activities; wealth management …
